svg.text: Magic Wand pen: inner features 1, grip and Nano bay
Enlarged details of the printed features that hold each part. Dimensions in mm; 3D-print clearances are included in the numbers.
DETAIL 1 Grip: FSR pocket, tail path, battery underneath (long section)

g.text: Spektrum 800 mAh on edge (continues to x = 69.6)

svg.text: Ø6 x 2 puck (TPU or hot glue),
glued on the FSR's active area
pocket Ø8.4 x 0.5 deep; FSR 0.3 on
tail groove 4.6 wide x 0.5, then a
2-pin header + 10 kΩ / 0.1 µF in the side
thumb button on the other side
0.5 gap between the cell and the
flat: the FSR never presses on it
cell stops against the tip at x = 18.6
Print the top shell's flat at 100 % infill
so the FSR is pressed against a rigid floor.
DETAIL 2 Thumb button mount (section at x = 36)
then a dab of hot glue
Thumb side shown on the left (looking from the rear).
DETAIL 3 Nano rail, hold-down finger and shell joint (x = 96)
(3 per side); 0.1 crush rib on the tip
rail block: 0.5 under the PCB edge, so
4 mm side gap PCB to wall (wires)
Split line at y = −1 (top of the PCB).
Close the shell and the PCB is clamped.
DETAIL 4 Screw bosses + locating rib (section at x = 71.25)
M2 x 10 pan head bites ≈ 3 mm
or M2 heat-set insert (Ø3.5 x 3) in a
stops the cell, passes the wires
Same boss at x = 26 and x = 129.25. Left: self-tapping. Right: heat-set insert. Pick one.
Magic Wand pen, rev D sketch, 2026-11-10. All dimensions in mm. Not to scale when printed; use the numbers.
